purpose: Select the minimum non-repeating path from current evidence to bounded DoV, recurse only on the first real blocker, and stop when further framework passes would add no new proof.

authority.rule: The controller may classify, route, validate, and request re-entry; it may not promote QPS engineering truth outside the QPS child authority.

method_catalog.3PR: Refresh and diagnose current content, runtime evidence, authority, and first blocker before choosing work.
method_catalog.MIP: Modernize, Innovate, and Perpetuate only when an observed structural or recurrence gap warrants improvement.
method_catalog.3PC: Prepare, Prove, and Commit a bounded publication, re-entry, acceptance, or exact-SHA transaction.
method_catalog.3P3: Run one propagation/generalisation proof only when local DoV is satisfied but reusable cross-repo proof is still missing.

selection_policy.minimum_work_rule: Select only methods that can create new evidence or remove a current blocker.
selection_policy.first_blocker_rule: When multiple reds exist, recurse on the earliest material observed blocker that gates the target transition.
selection_policy.repeat_rule: If a proposed pass would only restate an already-proved result without changing evidence, state, or protection, classify it REPEAT and do not run it.

scheduler_bindings.CG: target execution transition the controller is trying to admit
scheduler_bindings.EX: whether the intended validator/runtime/check actually executed
scheduler_bindings.KR: durable exact-SHA or equivalent receipt proving execution and result
scheduler_bindings.DR: whether required upstream/downstream dependencies are ready
scheduler_bindings.WD: bounded disposition: continue, defer, accept, reject, or stop
scheduler_bindings.PB: measured progress/burndown only; never authority by itself

execution_proof_rule.zero_step_rule: A workflow badge or completed job with zero executed intended validation steps cannot satisfy PASS.
execution_proof_rule.floating_ref_rule: Branch names, floating main, or unbound PR state cannot substitute for exact observed commit or artifact identity.

first_use_case.expected_decision: Classify current wave, run or request only the minimum useful method sequence, expose first BG and exact-SHA boundary, and stop when DoV is satisfied or further work would be repetition.
